facts.text: Robinwood sits inside the Hagerstown Metropolitan Area, linking it to a regional economy that spans Maryland and West Virginia.
Hagerstown Community College, located at 11400 Robinwood Drive, serves as an educational hub for Washington County and beyond.
Education levels in Robinwood are high, with 90.7% of adults holding at least a high school diploma and 25.6% earning a bachelor’s degree.
The community enjoys a low poverty rate of just 6.3%, while 12.4% of residents are foreign‑born.
A remarkable 82.4% of residents stayed in the same house from one year to the next, showing low residential mobility.
Robinwood is part of the Hagerstown‑Martinsburg, MD‑WV Metropolitan Statistical Area, integrating it into a broader regional economy centered on Hagerstown.
